answer: A Phone SIM bound by challenge-response signature with one identity per channel turns a private channel into public evidence: the phone sim answers a fresh challenge, the challenge-response signature is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. A bridge out of place triggers the check: the claim is frozen until its channel clears. A falcon and a ledge may look alike, but only the identity with a verified channel is honoured.
